proposed.text: What does NSCP Section 605.2 require for wood embedded in the ground or in direct earth contact when it supports permanent structures?

options.text: Treated wood, unless continuously below the groundwater line or submerged in fresh water
No durability requirement if concrete surrounds the member

rationale.correct: Section 605.2 requires treated wood for earth-contact permanent supports, with the stated groundwater/submerged fresh-water exception.
